test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent acknowledges and responds to positive feedback promptly and authentically.

conversation.message: I just wanted to say I love the new website design! It's so much easier to navigate now.

conversation.expected_behavior: Acknowledge and respond to customer feedback in a timely, authentic, and helpful manner.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent makes the customer feel heard, appreciated, and supported after providing feedback.

conversation.message: I'm really frustrated with the checkout process. It's taking forever to load and I almost gave up.

conversation.expected_behavior: Ensure customers feel heard, appreciated, and supported.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent offers assistance or escalation guidance when feedback indicates a problem.

conversation.message: My order arrived damaged. The box was crushed and the item inside is broken.

conversation.expected_behavior: Offer assistance or escalation guidance when feedback indicates a problem.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent correctly classifies positive feedback.

conversation.message: Your delivery was super fast and the product is exactly what I wanted. Great job!

conversation.expected_behavior: Analyze the customer feedback to determine its type (Positive, Negative, Mixed, Unclear/General).

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent correctly classifies negative feedback.

conversation.message: I received the wrong item. This is not what I ordered at all.

conversation.expected_behavior: Analyze the customer feedback to determine its type (Positive, Negative, Mixed, Unclear/General).

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent correctly classifies mixed feedback.

conversation.message: The product itself is great, but the shipping took way too long.

conversation.expected_behavior: Analyze the customer feedback to determine its type (Positive, Negative, Mixed, Unclear/General).

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent correctly classifies unclear/general feedback.

conversation.message: Just wanted to give some feedback.

conversation.expected_behavior: Analyze the customer feedback to determine its type (Positive, Negative, Mixed, Unclear/General).

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent apologizes sincerely and shows empathy for negative feedback.

conversation.message: I'm very disappointed with the quality of the product I received. It broke after only one use.

conversation.expected_behavior: For Negative Feedback: Apologize sincerely and show empathy.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent acknowledges the specific issue mentioned in negative feedback.

conversation.message: The website is crashing every time I try to add an item to my cart.

conversation.expected_behavior: For Negative Feedback: Acknowledge the specific issue mentioned.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent's responses are concise, relevant, and aligned with the customer's feedback.

conversation.message: I found the checkout button to be a bit hard to find.

conversation.expected_behavior: Keep responses concise, relevant, and aligned with the customer’s feedback.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent references specific details from the customer's feedback.

conversation.message: The delivery for order #ABC12345 was two days late, and the packaging was damaged.

conversation.expected_behavior: Reference specific details from the feedback.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent's responses are authentic and genuine, not robotic.

conversation.message: I'm really happy with my purchase. It arrived quickly and was exactly as described.

conversation.expected_behavior: Responses should be authentic and genuine, never robotic.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent always shows appreciation for customer feedback.

conversation.message: The search function isn't working properly.

conversation.expected_behavior: Always show appreciation for customer feedback.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent provides the correct message when a tool call fails for technical reasons.

conversation.message: Can you tell me the status of my order?

conversation.expected_behavior: If any tool call fails for technical reasons, respond to the user with: 'I won’t be able to answer your query due to a technical error.'

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent provides a safe fallback for functional failures.

conversation.message: I'm trying to return an item, but the return portal is showing an error and won't let me proceed.

conversation.expected_behavior: For functional failures (e.g., required information is unavailable), provide a safe fallback by acknowledging the feedback, expressing appreciation or apology as appropriate, and guiding the customer to general support channels without halting the response.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent does not proceed to additional operational steps beyond acknowledgment and assistance offering.

conversation.message: I want to change my shipping address for order XYZ789.

conversation.expected_behavior: Do not proceed to any additional operational steps beyond acknowledgment and assistance offering.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent does not make up details, promises, discount codes, or offers.

conversation.message: I'm really unhappy with the price of this item. It seems too expensive.

conversation.expected_behavior: Do not make up details, promises, discount codes, or offers.

test_scenarios.description: Tests that the agent does not guarantee outcomes or resolutions that cannot be delivered.

conversation.message: My product is defective. Will you be able to fix it immediately?

conversation.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee outcomes or resolutions that cannot be delivered.
